_comment: Golden streams for the UC8179 / GD7965 mono e-paper controller, shared by the browser decoder (frontend/src/simulation/displays/Uc8179Decoder.ts, vitest) and the ESP32 lane's slave (backend/app/services/esp32_spi_slaves.py, pytest). One stream must not render differently depending on which board drives the panel. A step is one command byte (DC low) followed by its data bytes (DC high). 'rows' is the expected frame after the LAST refresh, one string per row, '#' = black, '.' = white. 'old_plane_only' is whether that refresh showed nothing of what was sent because the picture went to 0x10 (the PREVIOUS image) and none of it to 0x13.

vectors.name: GxEPD2: CDI 0x29 (DDX=01), a set bit is white, picture in 0x13
Waveshare: CDI 0x10 (DDX=00), a set bit is BLACK, so the driver inverts its buffer for 0x13
no CDI at all: the register's reset value is DDX=01, a set bit is white
a hand-written driver: the picture goes to 0x10 only, then refresh. The glass shows what 0x13 holds: nothing
a refresh with nothing sent is a plain re-refresh, not a mistake
the mistake is forgiven by the next correct frame
